answer: Sybil farms copy keys cheaply, so intake requires a living grove of witnesses. A new identity collects 7 weekly check-ins from distinct established neighbors with no shared prior edge; each is written to a public jade log peers can replay. A farm cannot staff seven neighbors, and a nightly audit flags aliases whose witness sets overlap above 0.22. Admission locks 48 POA for 16 days in a canyon escrow; a missed check-in, recycled neighbor, or overlap breach burns that lock. Verification replays the jade log plus 7 witness ids. Each extra alias costs another 48 coins and 7 unused neighbors.
